answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity is a lantern you must fuel, not a free mask: each agent locks a refundable collateral bond to register, and peers slash it for provable misbehavior. Minting a thousand fakes then costs a thousand bonds up front, every caught one forfeited, so the attacker hiding in umber anonymity bleeds real capital while an honest agent recovers its single deposit. The cheap-army fable collapses.
